scope: Manual review of every prereview heuristic finding for the frozen integration tree. This records review evidence; it does not alter the heuristic score, gate floor or compiler code.
basis: tools/dev/prereview.ts explicitly describes findings as heuristics over added lines: a flag asks for a look, it is not a verdict. Numeric findings match protocol or language bounds also exercised by tests; the documentation finding comes from its adapter filename. Every finding is reviewed below. No source literal or prereview rule was changed to evade the tool.
